[color=#ffff00][head=3]In Character Interactions[/head][/color]
[color=#FFFACD]Whilst you are in a round you are expected to be interacting with the round as 'In Character' (IC). This means acting as your character would and performing their roles. Our goal is to create a community that allows you freedom to play a character you want. We may play evil or villainous characters, but that does not mean we are. Talk to each other OOC if there are issues, and work towards telling a story everyone enjoys. [/color]
IC interactions fall into three categories that help to maintain an MRP standard upon the server. - [textlink="Roleplay Standards" link="TriadRuleC3"] - [textlink="Escalation Guidelines" link="TriadRuleC4"] - [textlink="Job Roles" link="TriadRuleC5"]
